map.计算受均布荷载简支梁的最大弯矩、剪力、跨中挠度与跨中弯曲应力。: Maximum moment, shear, mid-span deflection and mid-span bending stress for a simply supported beam under a UDL.

map.楼板、次梁按简支估算跨中弯矩 Mmax=wL²/8 与剪力 Vmax=wL/2，: For floor slabs and secondary beams, take the mid-span moment Mmax = wL²/8 and shear Vmax = wL/2 as the governing forces for reinforcement and connection design.
map.校核变形：跨中挠度 f=5wL⁴/(384EI)，用于楼盖舒适度与净高控制。: Check deflection: the mid-span deflection f = 5wL⁴/(384EI) governs floor comfort and clear headroom.
map.对比不同跨度 L、线荷载 w 对弯矩的敏感度，优化梁高与材料用量。: Compare the sensitivity of the moment to span L and line load w, to optimise beam depth and material use.
map.4m 简支次梁均布荷载: 4 m simply supported secondary beam under UDL
map.跨度 L=4m、线荷载 w=10kN/m：Mmax=wL²/8=10×16/8=: For span L = 4 m and line load w = 10 kN/m: Mmax = wL²/8 = 10 × 16/8 = 20 kN·m; Vmax = wL/2 = 20 kN. If EI = 2.4 × 10¹¹ N·mm², the mid-span deflection f ≈ 5wL⁴/(384EI) (assessed
map.均布荷载与点荷载结果差多少？: How much do UDL and point load results differ?
map.同总荷载下，跨中弯矩点荷（PL/4）约为均布（wL²/8=PL/8）的 2 倍，: For the same total load the mid-span moment from a central point load (PL/4) is about twice that of a UDL (wL²/8 = PL/8). Load form therefore directly affects reinforcement and the two must not be mixed.
map.挠度超限怎么调？: What if the deflection exceeds the limit?
map.增大截面高度 h（挠度∝1/h³ 量级）、提高刚度 EI 或减小跨度；也可加反拱: Increase the section depth h (deflection scales roughly as 1/h³), raise the stiffness EI, or shorten the span. You can also add a camber or switch to a continuous beam to reduce the mid-span moment.
map.连续梁能按简支估算吗？: Can a continuous beam be estimated as simply supported?
map.不能。连续梁支座负弯矩显著大于简支跨中弯矩，简支结果会低估支座区配筋，需按连续梁: No. Support negative moments in a continuous beam are significantly larger than the mid-span moment of a simply supported beam, so a simply supported estimate understates support reinforcement. Use continuous-beam coefficients or a finite element check.

map.开裂判定：先按 GB 50010-2010 7.1.1 算 M_cr = f_t: Cracking check: first compute M_cr = f_tk·W_0 per GB 50010-2010 7.1.1 (W_0 = b·h²/6, without the plasticity influence factor γ, on the safe side); when M_q ≤ M_cr the member is uncracked, so B_s = E_c·I_0 (the long-term reduction B = B_s/θ is retained) and σ_s and ψ are not applicable; only when M_q > M_cr does the post-cracking path ψ → B_s → B apply

map.h₀ = h − a_s；a_s 为受拉钢筋合力点至受拉边缘距离（单排常取 35: h₀ = h − a_s; a_s is the distance from the tension edge to the centroid of tension reinforcement (typically 35 for a single layer and 60 for two layers), not the cover thickness c
map.强度等级 C25–C40 联动 f_tk 与 E_c，可手动覆盖；手动值与等级不: Strength grades C25–C40 link f_tk and E_c and can be overridden; if the manual values do not match the grade, the page warns against mixing, e.g. C25 strength with C40 stiffness
map.挠度按准永久组合：GB 50010-2010 3.4.3 规定钢筋混凝土受弯构件: Deflection uses the quasi-permanent combination: GB 50010-2010 3.4.3 requires the maximum deflection of RC flexural members to use the quasi-permanent load combination including long-term effects, so σ_s, ψ and B_s all use M_q (7.1.1-3 / 7.1.4 / 7.2.3), the long-term stiffness is B = B_s/θ (7.2.2-2) and δ_lt = 5M_qL²/(48B); the standard-combination B formula (7.2.2-1) applies only to prestressed members and is not used here
map.挠度限值按计算跨度 l₀ 分档（表 3.4.3）：l₀<7m → l₀/200、: Deflection limits are graded by effective span l₀ (Table 3.4.3): l₀/200 for l₀<7 m, l₀/250 for 7 m≤l₀≤9 m, l₀/300 for l₀>9 m; δ_lt ≤ limit is satisfied, and equality counts as satisfied
map.B_s = E_s·A_s·h₀²/[1.15ψ + 0.2 + 6α_Eρ/(: B_s = E_s·A_s·h₀²/[1.15ψ + 0.2 + 6α_Eρ/(1+3.5γ_f')], under the quasi-permanent combination
map.准永久组合：B = B_s ÷ θ；标准组合式 7.2.2-1 仅用于预应力构件: Quasi-permanent combination: B = B_s ÷ θ; the standard-combination Eq. 7.2.2-1 applies only to prestressed members
map.钢筋混凝土受弯构件的最大挠度按准永久组合并考虑长期作用；δ = 5M_qL²/(: RC flexural members: maximum deflection under the quasi-permanent combination including long-term effects; δ = 5M_qL²/(48B)
map.按计算跨度 l₀ 分档：l₀<7m 取 l₀/200；7m≤l₀≤9m 取 l₀: By effective span l₀: l₀/200 for l₀<7 m, l₀/250 for 7–9 m, l₀/300 for l₀>9 m; checked under the quasi-permanent combination

map.ρ′=0 取 2.0、ρ′=ρ 取 1.6、中间线性内插；受拉区翼缘的倒 T 形: 2.0 when ρ′=0, 1.6 when ρ′=ρ, linear interpolation in between; θ increases by 20% for inverted-T sections with the flange in the tension zone; computed automatically and editable
map.简支梁均布荷载：最大弯矩 M = qL² ÷ 8（kN·m）、最大剪力 V =: Simply supported beam under a UDL: maximum moment M = qL² ÷ 8 (kN·m), maximum shear V = qL ÷ 2 (kN), mid-span deflection δ = 5qL⁴ ÷ 384EI (elastic; q is first converted from kN/m to N/m and E from GPa×1e9 to Pa; I is taken automatically from b×h as I = bh³ ÷ 12, with cm⁴ converted by ×1e−8 to m⁴ and the result ×1000 to mm); section modulus W = bh² ÷ 6 (mm³), bending stress σ = M×1e6 ÷ W (MPa, with M converted from kN·m to N·mm). Validation: L, E, b, h must be >0 and q ≥0, otherwise 'Enter valid beam parameters' is shown. Note: I is read-only and uses the same section as the stress check, avoiding two conflicting section definitions. Load combinations: q_k is the characteristic combination UDL (characteristic value, used only for the M_k comparison and not in the deflection calculation) and q_q the quasi-permanent combination UDL (quasi-permanent value, not the design value after load partial factors); M_k = q_k·L² ÷ 8 and M_q = q_q·L² ÷ 8. Serviceability limit state (GB 50010-2010 3.4.3 / 7.2.1 / 7.2.2 / 7.2.3): the maximum deflection of an RC flexural member is calculated under the quasi-permanent combination including long-term effects, and σ_s, ψ and B_s likewise use the quasi-permanent combination (7.1.1-3 / 7.1.4 / 7.2.3). h₀ = h − a_s (a_s is the distance from the tension edge to the centroid of tension reinforcement, not the cover c); ρ = A_s ÷ (b·h₀), ρ_te = A_s ÷ (0.5·b·h) (take 0.01 if below 0.01), α_E = E_s ÷ E_c (E_s = 2×10⁵ MPa); σ_s = M_q ÷ (0.87·h₀·A_s); ψ = 1.1 − 0.65·f_tk ÷ (ρ_te·σ_s) (clamped to 0.2–1.0); B_s = E_s·A_s·h₀² ÷ [1.15ψ + 0.2 + 6α_Eρ ÷ (1+3.5γ_f')]; long-term stiffness under the quasi-permanent combination B = B_s ÷ θ (Eq. 7.2.2-2); θ is computed automatically per 7.2.5-1 from ρ′/ρ (2.0 when ρ′=0, 1.6 when ρ′=ρ, linear interpolation in between, ×1.2 for inverted T-sections with the flange in the tension zone) and can be overridden, with a warning when the manual value differs from the automatic one; δ_lt = 5·M_q·L² ÷ (48·B) (7.2.1 structural mechanics method); limits graded by effective span l₀ (l₀/200 for l₀<7 m, l₀/250 for 7 m≤l₀≤9 m, l₀/300 for l₀>9 m, Table 3.4.3), δ_lt ≤ limit is satisfied (equality counts as satisfied). The standard-combination long-term stiffness B = M_k ÷ [M_q(θ−1)+M_k]·B_s (Eq. 7.2.2-1) applies only to prestressed concrete members (3.4.3 requires their deflection to use the characteristic combination); this page covers reinforced concrete, so that path is not used and M_k is shown for reference only. Cracking check: first compute M_cr = f_tk·W_0 per GB 50010-2010 7.1.1 (W_0 = b·h²/6, without the plasticity influence factor γ, on the safe side); when M_q ≤ M_cr the member is uncracked, so B_s = E_c·I_0, ψ and σ_s are not applicable (the long-term stiffness is still reduced by B = B_s/θ); only when M_q > M_cr does the post-cracking path ψ → B_s → B apply.
map.q_k 为标准组合均布荷载（标准值），q_q 为准永久组合均布荷载（可变荷载准永: q_k is the characteristic combination UDL (characteristic value); q_q is the quasi-permanent combination UDL (the variable-load quasi-permanent factor ψ_q applied to the characteristic value and then combined with the permanent-load characteristic value). q_q is neither the design value after load partial factors nor a simple discount on the characteristic value; the page derives M_k = q_kL²/8 and M_q = q_qL²/8. q_k is used only for the M_k comparison and the 'q_q should not exceed q_k' consistency check; it does not enter any calculation of σ_s, ψ, B_s, B or δ (changing q_k only changes the M_k display, while δ stays the same)
map.θ 按 7.2.5-1 取用：ρ′ = 0 取 2.0、ρ′ = ρ 取 1.6: θ is taken per 7.2.5-1: 2.0 when ρ′ = 0, 1.6 when ρ′ = ρ, with linear interpolation in between; for inverted T-sections with the flange in the tension zone θ is increased by 20%. The page derives θ from the entered ρ′ together with A_s, b and h₀, fills it back into the input (changing ρ′ or the section type recomputes it), and still allows manual override; if the manual value differs from the automatic value by more than 0.01 a warning is shown and the manual value is used. ρ′ is entered in %, while ρ = A_s/(b·h₀) is a dimensionless ratio; units are normalized before interpolation
